Hi Sophie — thanks, and glad to hear the SOW is moving along. Short answers first: we can accommodate a PO-on-invoice requirement and consolidated monthly statements. Net45 is not our default (we typically run net30), but we can evaluate case-by-case. Below are the specifics procurement usually needs and the options we can propose to ClearRiver.

Required invoice/PO fields we need from your side:
- PO number (exact string)
- Billing entity (which ClearRiver legal entity the PO is for)
- Billing contact + email for remittance
- Tax ID for vendor setup

Redwood invoice options (what we can deliver):
- Monthly consolidated PDF statement + separate line-item invoice per month (PDF) — both will include PO number and ledger tags.
- CSV export of invoice line-items (for ERP ingestion) if your AP wants it.

Net terms & discounts
- Default: net30.
- Net45: we can grant net45 for enterprise deals with a minimum annual commitment and a short finance approval. Typical concessions we offer in exchange: 3-5% discount on listed rates for a 12-month committed spend or a small onboarding credit to offset DSO impact.
- Prepay/annual: we can provide a 6-12% effective discount for 12-month prepay.

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Template_v2.pdf (PO format we prefer) and Redwood-Invoice-Sample.pdf (example monthly statement).

Next steps:
1) Can AP confirm whether net45 is a hard requirement or a preference? (If hard, we'll fast-track finance approval.)
2) Sophie — if you can share expected ARR/commitment band for the first 12 months we can come back with a targeted discount.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call with procurement + AP to finalize the fields.

Best,

Hi Jasmine/Sophie — Rajesh on AP. Quick clarifications from our side:

- Net45 is a hard requirement for our vendor onboarding for services billed monthly unless the vendor is on our approved early-payment vendor list.
- We do require a single consolidated monthly statement delivered by the 5th business day after month-end.
- Each invoice line must reference the PO string exactly; if the PO changes across months, include the mapping in the statement.
- Remit-to: ACH preferred. We'll require W-9 (or W-8 as applicable) and Redwood's legal name + tax id.

If Redwood can agree to net45 we can commit to a streamlined onboarding and an accelerated vendor setup (typically 2-3 weeks). If not, we'll have to keep Redwood in a longer manual review path which delays the first invoice.

Happy to take a call to walk through the CSV/EDI mapping if needed.

Ben / Marissa — forwarding the thread from ClearRiver. Key asks: net45 (hard), consolidated monthly statement, PO on every invoice, W-9 + ACH remit. They also signaled faster onboarding if we accept net45.

My recommended negotiation position:
- Accept net45 for this deal only if they commit to a 12-month minimum spend of $240k (roughly $20k/mo). In return: a 4% discount off list rates for the initial 12 months and one month of free onboarding credit applied to the first invoice.
- Deliver consolidated monthly statement by day 5, include CSV line-item export for ERP ingestion at no extra cost.
- Confirm Redwood's W-9 and remit instructions (finance will provide).

Talking points for the counter-proposal to send to Rajesh/Sophie:
1) Redwood can accommodate net45 contingent on a 12-month committed spend of $240k (we can be flexible +/- 10% on the band).
2) We'll provide a 4% volume discount for months covered by the commitment and apply a one-time $10k onboarding credit to the first invoice.
3) We'll meet their invoicing format requirements (PDF statement + CSV line-items) and include PO mapping.

If they push back that net45 is non-negotiable without a larger discount, we should be ready to: (a) increase discount to 6% for a two-year commit, or (b) hold to net30 and offer 3% discount for 12 months.

I'll draft a short email to Rajesh/Sophie with the proposal once you thumbs-up. Thoughts?

Thanks,
Jasmine
